html:
For all my Polish fans out there, I am very pleased to let you know that my publisher in Poland, Fabryka Słów, has released the Polish language translation of the first two novels in my Rho Agenda series, The Second Ship and Immune. Here are the links to my pages on the Fabryka Słów website.

https://fabrykaslow.com.pl/autorzy/richard-phillips/drugi-okret-richard-phillips/

https://fabrykaslow.com.pl/autorzy/richard-phillips/remedium-projekt-rho-2/

comments.author: Bas
comments.html: Hi Richard! I very much enjoy reading your books. I especially admire all the science that went into the Rho agenda! I enjoyed reading your current fantasy work as well. I was just wondering, is there a chance you may revisit the hard sci-fi in another story in the future? Or perhaps you are working on something in that direction?

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html:
Thank you for reading my novels. Glad you enjoyed them. I certainly plan to write more SciFi as soon as I finish the Endarian Prophecy series. I want to look in on some of the Rho characters and explore the state of the worlds as I left them in the Rho Agenda.
Best,
Richard

comments.author: Adam
comments.html: I have read all Rho books and look forward for continuation.

comments.author: Roland
comments.html: Mr Phillips, I love your books. Any news on a possible Dutch edition of The Rho Agenda?

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html:
Hi Roland. Thank you. Unfortunately, we don’t yet have a deal with a Dutch publisher. I will let you know when that happens. I hope you have a great summer.
Best,
Richard
